verdict.rationale: Docs describe CSV/XLSX/XLS import with column-to-field mapping, duplicate detection, and an error-review UI that highlights bad rows in yellow for in-place fixing rather than silent dropping, plus API-based bulk import for larger migrations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that no rows are silently lost during real-world large or messy imports, and no detail on what happens to unresolved/invalid rows beyond the UI flagging step.
